newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ says RBA should wait on rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ says RBA should wait on rate cut.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group said on Wednesday it would prefer the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to wait until after economic data for January had been released before making a decision on a further cut in interest rates.
"I'm saying I'd wait a little longer and see," ANZ chairman Charles Goode told a news conference.
When asked if he thought if the central bank should wait until after January retail data is released before making a decision on rates, he said: "At least."
Goode noted that the Australian economy remained relatively flat.
Financially markets are expecting another cut in interest rates in the current quarter, fuelled most recently by warnings by retailers of poor Christmas trading.
Rates were last cut by 50 basis points to 6.0 percent on December 11.
